title: Purple Hammer Warrior
description: A female warrior with purple hair stands in a dynamic combat pose, swinging a massive purple warhammer with both hands. A powerful burst of white and purple energy explodes from the hammer's head toward the right side of the frame.
prompt: A fierce female warrior with short purple hair wearing white and purple fantasy armor stands in a powerful stance, swinging a giant purple warhammer with both hands. A massive white and purple magical energy explosion bursts from the hammer head. Comic book style, clean lines, vibrant colors, dramatic action pose, solid dark gray background.
